source_title: Mumbai Indians appoint Robin Uthappa as batting coach

File photo of Robin Uthappa. He was appointed as the batting coach for the Mumbai Indians for the forthcoming IPL 2027. File | Photo Credit: The Hindu
Former India batter Robin Uthappa was on Friday (October 30, 2026) appointed the batting coach of Mumbai Indians ahead of the 2027 Indian Premier League season.
A member of India’s victorious squad at the inaugural men’s T20 World Cup in 2007, the 40-year-old Uthappa had played for MI in the inaugural season of the league.
In a X post, Mumbai Indians said “From being part of our very first season to returning with a wealth of experience! Robbie brings a sharp understanding of the game, great communication, and the clarity to guide youngsters! Welcome back to the Paltan, Robin!”
From being part of our very first season to returning with a wealth of experience! Robbie brings a sharp understanding of the game, great communication, and the clarity to guide youngsters! 💪 Welcome back to the Paltan, Robin! आपला new Batting Coach. 💙 https://t.co/OrIsO6dqgi
The five-time IPL champion also appointed Mitchell McClenaghan as the bowling coach for the IPL 2027 season. In the social media post, the franchise said, “So, when Paltan said, 'Get Mitch!’ We got Mitch back home. A fan favourite who wore the badge on his sleeve and personified the MI spirit. Welcome home, Mitchell McClenaghan.”
In another revamp, the franchise brought T.K. Dilip as the fielding coach. In an X post, Mumbai Indians said, “From three ICC titles with India to unforgettable medal ceremony moments, T.K. Dilip has won fans over with his energy and passion. Now, he brings that same intensity to the Paltan as our Fielding Coach!”
They also brought in Dhawal Kulkarni as Development Bowling coach. The social media post by Mumbai Indians said “Mumbai’s very own, a domestic stalwart, and now our Development Bowling Coach. Welcome back, Dhawal Kulkarni!”
Mumbai Indians already promoted its batting coach Kieron Pollard as head coach last week replacing Mahela Jayawardene.

मुंबई इंडियंस ने 2027 इंडियन प्रीमियर लीग (आईपीएल) सीजन से पहले अपने कोचिंग स्टाफ में बड़े बदलाव किए हैं। 30 अक्टूबर, 2026 को फ्रेंचाइजी ने आधिकारिक तौर पर पूर्व भारतीय क्रिकेटर रॉबिन उथप्पा को टीम का नया बल्लेबाजी कोच नियुक्त किया है।

## कोचिंग स्टाफ में बदलाव
2007 टी20 विश्व कप विजेता टीम के सदस्य रहे उथप्पा ने लीग के शुरुआती सीजन में मुंबई इंडियंस के लिए खेला था। फ्रेंचाइजी ने खेल की उनकी गहरी समझ और युवा खिलाड़ियों को मार्गदर्शन देने की क्षमता को उनके 'पलटन' में वापसी का मुख्य कारण बताया है।

उथप्पा की नियुक्ति के अलावा, फ्रेंचाइजी ने हेड कोच कीरोन पोलार्ड, जिन्हें हाल ही में महेला जयवर्धने की जगह पदोन्नत किया गया है, की मदद के लिए अन्य महत्वपूर्ण नियुक्तियां की हैं:

*   **मिचेल मैक्लेनाघन:** गेंदबाजी कोच नियुक्त किए गए।
*   **टी.के. दिलीप:** फील्डिंग कोच नियुक्त किए गए, जो भारतीय राष्ट्रीय टीम के साथ अपने अनुभव को यहां जोड़ेंगे।
*   **धवल कुलकर्णी:** डेवलपमेंट बॉलिंग कोच के रूप में शामिल हुए।

ये नियुक्तियां पांच बार की चैंपियन टीम के लिए एक संक्रमण काल का हिस्सा हैं। प्रशंसकों और समर्थकों को सलाह दी जाती है कि वे टीम की तैयारियों और आधिकारिक टूर्नामेंट घोषणाओं के बारे में अधिक जानकारी के लिए मुंबई इंडियंस के सोशल मीडिया चैनलों और आईपीएल की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट पर नजर रखें।

en_body:
Mumbai Indians have announced a significant restructuring of their coaching staff ahead of the 2027 Indian Premier League (IPL) season. On October 30, 2026, the franchise officially appointed former Indian cricketer Robin Uthappa as the team's new batting coach.

## Coaching Staff Restructuring
Uthappa, a member of the 2007 T20 World Cup-winning squad, previously played for Mumbai Indians during the league's inaugural season. The franchise highlighted his deep understanding of the game and his ability to mentor younger players as key factors for his return to the 'Paltan'.

In addition to Uthappa's appointment, the franchise has made several other key staff changes to support head coach Kieron Pollard, who was recently promoted to the role replacing Mahela Jayawardene:

*   **Mitchell McClenaghan:** Appointed as the bowling coach.
*   **T.K. Dilip:** Appointed as the fielding coach, bringing experience from his tenure with the Indian national team.
*   **Dhawal Kulkarni:** Appointed as the Development Bowling coach.

These appointments follow a period of transition for the five-time champions as they prepare for the upcoming IPL cycle. Fans and stakeholders are encouraged to monitor the official Mumbai Indians social media channels and the IPL website for further updates regarding team preparations and official tournament announcements.
